name: Graph Connected Components Labeling via Min-ID Propagation
description: Graph connected components partition isolated clusters of customers or machines. Propagating the minimum account ID across edges assigns every node in the same component a shared group ID.
prompt:
Graph connected components partition isolated clusters of customers or machines. Propagating the minimum account ID across edges assigns every node in the same component a shared group ID.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: node_id, cluster_id.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Symmetric edges
            WITH RECURSIVE symmetric_edges AS (
                SELECT node_a AS src, node_b AS dst FROM graph_edges
                UNION
                SELECT node_b AS src, node_a AS dst FROM graph_edges
            ),
            components AS (
                -- Anchor: Initial component label is node itself
                SELECT src AS node_id, src AS component_id, 0 AS iteration
                FROM symmetric_edges
                
                UNION ALL
                
                -- Propagate smaller component ID across edges
                SELECT 
                    e.dst AS node_id,
                    c.component_id,
                    c.iteration + 1
                FROM components c
                JOIN symmetric_edges e ON c.node_id = e.src
                WHERE c.component_id < e.dst AND c.iteration < 5
            )
            SELECT 
                node_id,
                MIN(component_id) AS cluster_id
            FROM components
            GROUP BY node_id
            ORDER BY cluster_id, node_id;
why_it_fails: Standard SQL engines lack graph primitives, forcing expensive external graph database licenses.
